LEFT JOIN ( SELECT contest_id, COUNT(*) AS prepare_count FROM contest_submission_prepare WHERE updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) OR created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY contest_id ) prep ON prep.contest_id = c.contest_id

SELECT FROM contest c
WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.status = #{filter.status}
AND c.contest_type = #{filter.contestType}
AND (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') OR c.organizer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') OR c.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%'))
AND c.deadline_at >= NOW()
AND c.deadline_at <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND c.deadline_at <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND c.deadline_at <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND ( JSON_CONTAINS(c.target_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('ANYONE')) OR JSON_CONTAINS(c.target_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE(#{code})) )
AND JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('ONLINE'))
AND ( JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('NATIONWIDE')) OR JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('ALL')) )
AND ( JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('CAPITAL')) OR JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('SEOUL')) OR JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('INCHEON')) OR JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('GYEONGGI')) )
AND c.region_codes_json IS NOT NULL AND JSON_LENGTH(c.region_codes_json) > 0 AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('ONLINE')) AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('NATIONWIDE')) AND NOT JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('ALL'))
AND ( JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE('ALL')) OR JSON_CONTAINS(c.region_codes_json, JSON_QUOTE(#{code})) )
AND c.organizer_type IN #{code}
AND c.total_prize_amount >= #{filter.totalPrizeMin} AND c.total_prize_amount <= #{filter.totalPrizeMax} AND c.first_prize_amount >= #{filter.firstPrizeMin} AND c.first_prize_amount <= #{filter.firstPrizeMax} ORDER BY
c.created_at DESC popularScore DESC, c.save_count DESC, c.created_at DESC c.deadline_at ASC c.deadline_at ASC, c.contest_id ASC
LIMIT #{filter.limit}

SELECT FROM contest c
WHERE c.status = 'OPEN' AND c.deadline_at > NOW() ORDER BY c.deadline_at ASC, c.contest_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.profile_id AS profileId, 'PROFILE' AS basisType, p.display_name AS title, p.short_intro AS summary, p.experience_level AS experienceLevel, p.collaboration_status AS collaborationStatus, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.name ORDER BY r.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS roleNames, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS genreNames FROM member_profile p LEFT JOIN profile_role pr ON pr.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = pr.role_id LEFT JOIN profile_genre pg ON pg.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = pg.genre_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.profile_completed_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY p.profile_id, p.display_name, p.short_intro, p.experience_level, p.collaboration_status

SELECT p.profile_id AS profileId, 'PROFILE' AS basisType, p.display_name AS title, p.short_intro AS summary, p.experience_level AS experienceLevel, p.collaboration_status AS collaborationStatus, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.name ORDER BY r.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS roleNames, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS genreNames FROM member_profile p LEFT JOIN profile_role pr ON pr.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = pr.role_id LEFT JOIN profile_genre pg ON pg.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = pg.genre_id WHERE p.profile_id = #{profileId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.profile_completed_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY p.profile_id, p.display_name, p.short_intro, p.experience_level, p.collaboration_status

SELECT t.team_id AS teamId, 'TEAM' AS basisType, t.name AS title, t.description AS summary, t.status, t.expected_duration AS expectedDuration, t.current_member_count AS currentMemberCount, t.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS genreNames, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.name ORDER BY r.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS roleNames FROM team_member tm JOIN team t ON t.team_id = tm.team_id LEFT JOIN team_genre tg ON tg.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = tg.genre_id LEFT JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.recruitment_id = tr.recruitment_id LEFT JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status IN ('RECRUITING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RECRUITMENT_CLOSED', 'CLOSING') GROUP BY t.team_id, t.name, t.description, t.status, t.expected_duration, t.current_member_count, t.max_member_count ORDER BY t.last_active_at DESC

SELECT t.team_id AS teamId, 'TEAM' AS basisType, t.name AS title, t.description AS summary, t.status, t.expected_duration AS expectedDuration, t.current_member_count AS currentMemberCount, t.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS genreNames, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.name ORDER BY r.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS roleNames FROM team_member tm JOIN team t ON t.team_id = tm.team_id LEFT JOIN team_genre tg ON tg.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = tg.genre_id LEFT JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.recruitment_id = tr.recruitment_id LEFT JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.team_id = #{teamId} GROUP BY t.team_id, t.name, t.description, t.status, t.expected_duration, t.current_member_count, t.max_member_count

SELECT prepare_id AS prepareId, contest_id AS contestId, user_id AS userId, basis_type AS basisType, basis_id AS basisId, checklist_json AS checklistJson, memo, click_count AS clickCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM contest_submission_prepare WHERE contest_id = #{contestId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND basis_type = #{basisType} AND basis_id = #{basisId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contest_submission_prepare ( contest_id, user_id, basis_type, basis_id, checklist_json, memo, click_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{contestId}, #{userId}, #{basisType}, #{basisId}, #{checklistJson}, #{memo}, 1, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checklist_json = VALUES(checklist_json), memo = VALUES(memo), click_count = click_count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
